newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Tissue applies for Dermagraft ok.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Tissue applies for Dermagraft ok.

text.p: Advanced Tissue Sciences Inc said on Friday it submitted a premarket approval application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Dermagraft product to be used to treat diabetic foot ulcers.
Advanced Tissue Sciences also said it has signed a joint venture agreement with Smith & Nephew Plc for worldwide commercialization of Dermagraft, a bioengineered tissue replacement product.
"We are now in the process of supporting the FDA's expedited review of the Dermagraft PMA," Arthur Benvenuto, chief executive officer, said..

The application is based on results of a clinical trial in which Dermagraft, within a specific dose range, was more effective in achieving complete healing and in reducing the time to healing than the standard of care used in the control, the company said.
Patients receiving Dermagraft product within the therapeutic range represented a majority but not all of the evaluable Dermagraft-treated patients enrolled in the pivotal trial.
